name: erp_inventory_levels_list
description: List per-location inventory balances for stocked items, optionally filtered by item or location (POST /services/rest/query/v1/suiteql - inventorybalance)

item.description: Item id / SKU filter, e.g. HW-DFA-100.

location.description: Location name filter: Newark DC, London DC or Frankfurt DC.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).
